name: KageCatch Codespace - Remote Commander test
postAttachCommand: bash -lc 'set -eu; LOG="$PWD/.codespace-remote-commander.log"; EXCLUDE="$(git rev-parse --git-path info/exclude)"; grep -qxF "/.codespace-remote-commander.log" "$EXCLUDE" || printf "\n/.codespace-remote-commander.log\n" >> "$EXCLUDE"; if ! pgrep -f "[d]esktop-commander.*remote" >/dev/null 2>&1; then nohup npx --yes @wonderwhy-er/desktop-commander@latest remote >"$LOG" 2>&1 </dev/null & fi; sleep 12; echo "Remote Commander startup log: $LOG"; tail -n 25 "$LOG" || true'
